page_title: WOL 2-1 RBL | Wolfsburg v RB Leipzig 25/11/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' There will be no more action in this match as the referee signals full time.
90+2' Koen Casteels (Wolfsburg) violates the rules and gets a yellow card.
90+2' Xavi Simons (RB Leipzig) releases a superb dipping volley at goal from the edge of the box that flies just over the bar.
90+2' RB Leipzig take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
90' There will be a minimum of 5 min. of added time.
87' Rogerio (Wolfsburg) attempts to find the head of one of his teammates with a promising cross into the box, but a defender outjumps the attackers and averts the threat.
84' Niko Kovac has decided to substitute Jonas Wind and he is replaced by Tiago Tomas (Wolfsburg).
83' The substitution is prepared. Nicolas Seiwald (RB Leipzig) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Amadou Haidara.
83' The game has come to an end for Christoph Baumgartner. He has contributed as much as he could today. He will be replaced by the fresh legs of Fabio Carvalho (RB Leipzig).
83' Substitution. Mattias Svanberg makes his way off the pitch and Yannick Gerhardt (Wolfsburg) comes on as his replacement.
83' RB Leipzig have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
82' The corner is swung in but RB Leipzig can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
79' Robert Hartmann shows a yellow card to Xavi Simons (RB Leipzig) for his blatant foul.
77' It will be a substitution. Maximilian Arnold (Wolfsburg) is ready to enter the pitch as Lovro Majer walks off.
76' RB Leipzig have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
75' Xavi Simons (RB Leipzig) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked. The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to RB Leipzig.
73' Marco Rose has decided to make a change. Emil Forsberg (RB Leipzig) replaces Yussuf Poulsen.
73' Substitution. Vaclav Cerny did his best and is replaced by Kevin Paredes (Wolfsburg).

71' Xaver Schlager (RB Leipzig) is obviously not following the Golden Rule: "Treat others as you want to be treated.“ He makes a bad challenge and leaves Robert Hartmann with no other option than to blow for a foul.
66' 2 - 1 Rogerio (Wolfsburg) connects with a pass inside the box and slams home into the top right corner. The goalkeeper was helpless.
63' A player from RB Leipzig commits an attacking foul. The referee blows his whistle.
63' The resulting set piece from RB Leipzig is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
61' A goal, which was scored by Lois Openda (RB Leipzig), was disallowed due to offside.
59' Maxence Lacroix (Wolfsburg) has tested the patience of referee Robert Hartmann and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
57' Lovro Majer (Wolfsburg) goes down under a challenge in the box, but the ref immediately waves away the appeals from all players.
56' Lois Openda (RB Leipzig) attempts to score with a first-time shot from the edge of the box. His effort towards the bottom right corner is saved by Koen Casteels.
56' RB Leipzig failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
55' David Raum (RB Leipzig) whips in the corner, but one of the defending players gets a head on it and intercepts.
55' David Raum (RB Leipzig) attempts to send over a cross in order to find one of his teammates, but an opposition defender averts the danger by intercepting the effort. Now RB Leipzig have a corner.
52' 1 - 1 Goal! Lois Openda puts the ball on a plate for Yussuf Poulsen (RB Leipzig), who scores with a simple close-range finish. It's 1:1.
51' Xavi Simons (RB Leipzig) delivers a crossfield pass, but the ball is cut out before it reaches its intended target.
49' Xaver Schlager (RB Leipzig) slides a pass forward, but one of the defenders cuts it out.
47' The defence is alert as they clear a dangerous cross from Xavi Simons (RB Leipzig).
46' Substitution. Sebastiaan Bornauw leaves the pitch and is replaced by Moritz Jenz (Wolfsburg).
46' The referee blows his whistle to signal the start of the second half.
45+5' That is it for the first half after the referee blows his whistle and the players head to their respective dressing rooms.
45+4' Yellow card. Cedric Zesiger (Wolfsburg) goes into the book for a bad tackle on his opponent.
45+3' RB Leipzig take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
45' 4 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
45' The current number of shots on goal is 2:6.
44' One of the defenders reacts at the last minute to brilliantly block a pass from David Raum (RB Leipzig).

41' Amadou Haidara (RB Leipzig) meets a delivery on the edge of the penalty area and shoots towards the top right corner. He didn't put enough power into the effort, though, and Koen Casteels pulls off an easy save.
38' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by RB Leipzig, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
37' Xavi Simons (RB Leipzig) is moving okay again after that injury scare.
36' Xavi Simons (RB Leipzig) is asking for medical treatment after picking up an injury.
35' The whistle is blown for an infringement and Mattias Svanberg (Wolfsburg) receives a yellow card!
33' Lois Openda (RB Leipzig) violates the laws of the game and is shown a deserved yellow card by the referee.
33' Referee Robert Hartmann reverses his original decision after the VAR review. There was no infringement and subsequently it’s not a penalty.
32' Wait a minute! The referee has decided to review the penalty decision using the VAR system.
31' Sebastiaan Bornauw (Wolfsburg) pulls the jersey of one of the opposition players and Robert Hartmann blows his whistle for a foul. RB Leipzig are awarded a penalty kick!
26' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for RB Leipzig.
26' Rogerio (Wolfsburg) was too fierce in his attempt to get the ball from his opponent and Robert Hartmann blows for a foul.
24' Castello Lukeba (RB Leipzig) escapes without any punishment from the referee after using excessive force to foul his opponent.

22' Yussuf Poulsen (RB Leipzig) attempts to convert a lofted cross as he jumps high and heads the ball to the middle of the goal. Koen Casteels shows his brilliant reflexes and pulls off a glorious save to stop the ball from hitting the net.
21' RB Leipzig can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
19' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from RB Leipzig comes to nothing.
16' Benjamin Henrichs (RB Leipzig) serves up a nice cross, but the defence clears the danger.
13' Sebastiaan Bornauw (Wolfsburg) commits a rough challenge and Robert Hartmann blows his whistle for an infringement.
11' Robert Hartmann blows for a foul after David Raum (RB Leipzig) was too aggressive in the battle for the ball.
9' 1 - 0 It's a goal! Jonas Wind (Wolfsburg) does well to meet a cross inside the box and strikes a perfect header into the roof of the net.
9' Xavi Simons (RB Leipzig) swings in a cross, but the ball is cleared to safety by one of the defending players.
7' The resulting corner from Vaclav Cerny (Wolfsburg) is cleared by the defence.

7' He should have scored! Mattias Svanberg (Wolfsburg) latches onto a pull back in the box right in front of goal, but his shot towards the roof of the net is pretty weak and Janis Blaswich makes an easy save. Wolfsburg have been awarded a corner kick.
4' Mohamed Simakan (RB Leipzig) connects with the corner kick around the penalty spot, but steers his header just wide of the right post.
4' RB Leipzig win a corner.

3' Mohamed Simakan (RB Leipzig) wasted a huge opportunity! He received a fine cross from the free kick and fired a decent shot in from close range. Unfortunately for him, it sailed just over the crossbar!
2' A mid-range free kick is awarded to RB Leipzig out wide and from this angle a cross into the box is likely.
1' The referee blows his whistle and we are underway.
The players are out at last! RB Leipzig will take the kick-off.
Today's referee will be Robert Hartmann.
